## What changed

Describe the user/engineering problem and the smallest coherent solution.

## Why this design

Explain the evidence behind the decision. Call out any existing behaviour or architecture deliberately replaced rather than preserved.

## Verification

List the exact tests/checks run and their results. Do not claim checks that were not executed.

## Scientific / data impact

If applicable, identify sources, releases, units, provenance, uncertainty, transformations, and attribution changes.

## Accessibility / degraded behaviour

If applicable, cover keyboard, screen reader, zoom/reflow, reduced motion, touch, WebGL-off, offline, and provider-failure behaviour.

## Security / privacy / cost

Confirm that the change does not leak secrets/private data and note new external services, storage, location/upload handling, or recurring cost.

## Scope

List intentional follow-ups or things deliberately left unchanged.
